entries.title: Ephesians 6:1
segments: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:2
segments: Honor your father and mother (which is the first commandment with a promise),

entries.title: Ephesians 6:3
segments: so that it may be well with you, and that you may live long on the earth.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:4
segments: And fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath, but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:5
segments: Slaves, obey [your] masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;

entries.title: Ephesians 6:6
segments: not with eye-service, as men-pleasers, but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from [the] heart,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:7
segments: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men

entries.title: Ephesians 6:8
segments: (knowing that whatever good thing he does, he shall receive the same from the Lord, whether [he is] a slave or a freeman).

entries.title: Ephesians 6:9
segments: And masters, do the same things to them, forbearing threatening, knowing that your Master also is in Heaven. There is no respect of persons with Him.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:10
segments: Finally, my brothers, be strong in [the] Lord and in the power of His might.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:11
segments: Put on the whole armor of God so that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:12
segments: For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the world's rulers, of the darkness of this age, against spiritual wickedness in high [places].

entries.title: Ephesians 6:13
segments: Therefore take to yourselves the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:14
segments: Therefore stand, having your loins girded about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness

entries.title: Ephesians 6:15
segments: and your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:16
segments: Above all, take the shield of faith, with which you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:17
segments: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the Word of God,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:18
segments: praying always with all prayer and supplication in [the] Spirit, and watching to this very thing with all perseverance and supplication for all saints.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:19
segments: And pray for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:20
segments: for which I am an ambassador in bonds; so that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:21
segments: But, so that you also may know my affairs [and] how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in [the] Lord, shall make known to you all things,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:22
segments: whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that you might know our affairs and [that] he might comfort your hearts.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:23
segments: Peace to the brothers, and love with faith, from God [the] Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:24
segments: Grace [be] with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
